resources.string: Reading the brokerage report. This may take a minute…
Use the plus button to add a broker account: connect a broker to sync holdings, or keep a manual account. View reports only; no orders or transfers.
Add Cash Report to the Flex Query to include cash and margin.
No open positions in this report
Remove the credentials and holdings cached on this phone. Brokerage and bookkeeping accounts are unchanged. To revoke the token, generate a new one in IBKR.

In IBKR Client Portal, open Reports → Flex Queries and create an Activity Flex Query:

• Format: XML; date format: yyyyMMdd; period: Last Business Day
• Add Open Positions, choose Summary and all fields, not Lots
• Add Cash Report with currency breakdown so idle cash and margin debit are included
• Save the Query ID; enable Flex Web Service and generate a token

Keep empty Open Positions and Cash Report sections when those balances are zero.

The token grants access to reports. Keep it private. Credentials and holdings are encrypted on this device, excluded from backups, and sent directly to IBKR, not a Hootbook server. Reconnect after reinstalling.
